name: Randis
summary: In Cathedral Square, Randis longs to see the lands beyond Stormwind. During Children's Week, he eagerly travels with willing adventurers across Alliance lands.

sections.title: A Ward of Stormwind
sections.body: Randis lives in the orphanage near Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. The realm's conflicts have left many children without family. Each year during Children's Week, Orphan Matron Nightingale gives a whistle to sympathetic heroes and entrusts them with Randis's care. Curious and full of questions, he dreams of adventure and asks riddles. He says he wants to be king of Stormwind when he grows up.

sections.title: Eyes on the World
sections.body: Most days, Randis stays in Cathedral Square, so leaving the capital feels like a grand adventure. He remarks that places like Ironforge smell odd. His wonder shows what Alliance heroes fight to protect.

faq.answer: Randis is a human child at the Stormwind Orphanage in Cathedral Square. During Children's Week, willing adventurers can look after him and take him across Alliance lands.
During Children's Week, Orphan Matron Nightingale gives adventurers an orphan whistle in Cathedral Square. Blow it, and Randis comes along on your travels.

faq.q: What places does Randis want to visit?
faq.answer: Randis wants to visit anywhere beyond Stormwind's walls with the hero who takes him along. He has visited Ironforge and says it smells funny there.

faq.q: Why is Randis living in an orphanage?
faq.answer: Randis lives in an orphanage because constant wars, invasions, and hardships across Stormwind and Azeroth have taken his parents. Many children in Matron Nightingale's care share that loss.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, caring for Randis during Children's Week reminds you that your battles protect the next generation of civilians and dreamers.
